title: What If Everyone On Earth Was Born On The Same Day?

scenes.notes: STORY extreme wide (impossible frame 0): `whatif/Set` `ward` = the crib field: side-on rows of cribs to the horizon at dawn (per-row scale for depth, `whatif/Crowd` age baby capped at 480 near cribs + static pattern fade beyond row 4). Cribs are empty; 4 light up amber each second. Corner `explainer/Stat` counter `BIRTHS THIS SECOND: 4`. One front crib carries the cream YOU ring, still empty. `whatif/Pill` `~132 MILLION A YEAR`.
BOARD graphic: Navy board: 60 rows x 365 columns of amber dots labelled `60 YEARS OF BIRTHS` slide together from both sides into one bright block; `explainer/Tag` `ONE MORNING`.

STORY wide: Back on the crib field: every crib fills at once with an amber baby (`whatif/Crowd` fill 0 -> 1 in 0.5 s); the YOU crib's baby gets its cream ring. `whatif/Hud` fades in top-left `YEAR 0 · EVERYONE IS 0`.
STORY extreme wide: The full field, tiny `waa` glyphs popping above cribs; cream milk-steam `particles` (dust preset, rising) drift across. HUD `BABIES 8,000,000,000`.
STORY medium: Grey adult `whatif/Person` (pose hold) figures stand up between the cribs, one per four cribs; one holds the YOU baby. HUD adds `ADULTS 2,000,000,000`.

BOARD trailer: Navy board; `whatif/Scrubber` draws in along the bottom (DAY 1 -> 125). Ticks pop with the VO: bottle `DAY 1`, desk `6`, rocking chair `65`, each with a small vignette above it (one grey adult + 4 cribs; a 9x10 grid of kids; one calendar page `MONDAY`).

STORY close-up: `whatif/Set` `kitchen` at night: `whatif/Cake` with a forest of ~120 unlit candles, one candle in front; scrubber end tick `?` with candle icon; HUD line `YOUR ODDS OF BEING THE LAST: 1 IN 8,000,000,000`; amber light falls off at the edges (`grade` vignette 0.45).

props.text: WHAT IF EVERYONE ON EARTH WAS BORN ON THE SAME DAY?

scenes.notes: TITLE card (5 s, music only): `explainer/Headline` in Anton, centred on navy: What If Everyone On Earth Was Born On _The Same Day_? (keyword amber); behind it a single amber bar (`whatif/Pyramid`, one band at age 0).
BOARD: `explainer/Tag` `NO CLONES` then `NO TIME MACHINE`, each crossed by an animated red strike-through `rect` (no clone-vat or time-machine drawings); then `SAME PLANET · SAME CITIES`.

BOARD signature shot (GATE SHOT, part 1): `whatif/Pyramid` starts as the real 2024 world pyramid (21 bands, male left / female right, data in storyboard), then `morph` over 3 s: every band drains sideways into one amber bar at age 0. Fixed x-scale: 0.7 BN = 40% of half-width; the 8 BN bar (x12) clips at the board edge with an overflow chevron and a `×12` label; camera eases out (zoom 1 -> 0.85) as the bar lands.

BOARD (GATE SHOT, part 2): Pyramid adds grey bands at ages 20-45 labelled `THE OLD WORLD · 2,000,000,000 ON LOAN`; `whatif/IconRows` `1 ADULT : 4 BABIES` inset bottom-right; `whatif/Pill` source `infant-care ratio guidance`.
BOARD detail: `whatif/Scrubber` returns with a new tick at 30 (key icon); chip `HANDOVER IN 30 YEARS`; on r5 a red pin drops onto the grey bands; `explainer/Tag` `KEEP THIS DATE`.

STORY wide: Back to the crib field; paper bunting and one balloon per front-row crib pop up; HUD switches to `TOTAL ALIVE 10,000,000,000` / `YOUR AGE GROUP 8,000,000,000`; the scrubber dot starts moving.
STAMP: `whatif/YearStamp` full width `DAY 1` / `EIGHT BILLION BIRTHDAYS` (Anton).
BOARD: `explainer/SpeedBars`: `NORMAL DAY ~360,000` (thin) vs `TODAY 8,000,000,000` (runs off the right edge); `whatif/Pill` `~60 YEARS OF BIRTHS`.

STORY close-up (one-person rung): `whatif/Set` `ward` at night, close: one grey adult `whatif/Person` (pose hold) between four cribs, the YOU baby in one; a wall `explainer/Timer` (ring) spinning fast; the `DAY 1` bottle tick lights (promise 1 paid). On d5: `explainer/Stat` `40 FEEDS + 40 DIAPERS` / `PER ADULT, PER DAY (EST.)` and a pile of instanced diaper icons grows beside the adult, with `explainer/Bus` for scale.

BOARD consequence chain: Three navy panels light in sequence: power station, farm, hospital icons, each with a red `UNSTAFFED?` tag. On d7: `explainer/SpeedBars` `JOBS YESTERDAY ~3.5 BN` vs `ADULTS TODAY 2 BN · ALL ON NIGHT FEEDS`; source ILO.
BOARD: The three `UNSTAFFED?` tags flip to green ticks; `explainer/Tag` `RULE 2: LIGHTS ON · NOBODY HUNGRY`.
STORY button: The adult from s16 asleep standing up; all four babies wide awake; `explainer/Tag` `SLEEP: 0`.

STORY wide, warm: `whatif/Set` `park`: a wave of amber toddlers (`whatif/Crowd` age kid, pose walk) take first steps left to right, each holding a grey adult's hand; the YOU toddler mid-frame; corner `whatif/YearStamp` `YEAR 1`; Tag `FIRST STEPS: EVERYONE`.

STORY gag: Split: left, `explainer/Map` at global zoom, every continent highlighted amber, plain amber pins (no cake glyphs); right, `whatif/Set` `kitchen` counter where a receipt `rect` rolls off the bottom of frame: `ORDER: 8,000,000,000 CAKES`.
STORY: `whatif/Set` `park` playground: a swing set full of same-size amber toddlers, no older kids anywhere; Tag `OLDEST KID ON THE SWINGS: 1`.
STORY transition: The park freezes (all idles stop); the desk tick on `whatif/Scrubber` blinks.
STAMP: `whatif/YearStamp` `YEAR 6` / `FIRST DAY OF SCHOOL`.
STORY wide: `whatif/Set` `classroom` (door view): a queue of amber kids with backpack icons wraps out of the door and off-frame.

STORY interior: `whatif/Set` `classroom`: one grey teacher `whatif/Person` (pose point) at the chalkboard facing a 9 x 10 grid of amber kids on the floor; the YOU kid ringed in the back row; `explainer/Stat` `~90` / small grey `TODAY ~23`; the desk tick lights (promise 2 paid).
BOARD: `explainer/Map` flies from global to Romania via `views` (lon 25, lat 46, zoom 5); a pin + pulsing ring at (25, 46) labelled `ROMANIA` (no country polygon); chip `1966`.
BOARD: Two bars grow side by side: `1966 ~274,000` -> `1967 ~528,000`; source line `INS Romania (verify)`.

BOARD cascade: The 1967 bulge as one amber block on a mini Romania pyramid slides upward through three labelled gates `MATERNITY` -> `SCHOOL` -> `UNIVERSITY`, each flashing red as it squeezes through.
BOARD comparison: `explainer/SpeedBars` `ROMANIA ×2` (short) vs `YOU ×22,000` (runs off-frame).
STORY button: `whatif/Set` `park` from very high: rows of amber kids filling every field to the horizon (static pattern); a white camera-flash `rect` pulse; Tag `YEAR-GROUP PHOTO: 7,700,000,000`.
STAMP: `whatif/YearStamp` `YEAR 18` / `EVERYONE GRADUATES`.
STORY wide: `whatif/Set` `classroom` (hall): rows of amber teens toss mortarboard icons at the same instant; the YOU teen front-left.
STORY: 32 chair icons in a row, one lit amber with a mortarboard; 31 amber teens look at it; `whatif/Pill` `~250 M UNIVERSITY PLACES`.

STORY wide: `whatif/Set` `office`: grey old-world `whatif/Person` figures (pose sit) at desks behind glass; an amber queue (the YOU teen near the front) runs out of the door and off-frame as an amber path; `explainer/Stat` `~3.5 BN JOBS` / `8 BN APPLICANTS`.

BOARD: `explainer/Map` to Spain via `views` (lon -3.7, lat 40.4, zoom 5) with a pin + ring `SPAIN`; chip `2013`; `whatif/Pill` `SPAIN, UNDER-25 UNEMPLOYMENT ~56%`. On 'planet' the view pulls to global and all six continent keys highlight amber. Shot holds 0.8 s past 'planet'.
STORY button: `whatif/Set` `park` bench: two amber 18-year-old `whatif/Person`s (pose sit), identical height; Tag `AGE GAP: 0`.
STORY: Same bench, now with a stroller icon beside it; across the park a whole row of strollers pops in at once.

BOARD: Corner `whatif/YearStamp` `YEAR 24` over `whatif/Pyramid`: amber bar at 24, grey bands at 44-69, teal echo bands growing at ages 0-5; `whatif/Pill` `~2.2 CHILDREN PER WOMAN`; HUD `TOTAL ALIVE` counts 9.9 -> 11.8 BN.
BOARD: Tag `THE ECHO`; inset mini Japan pyramid with two bulges, chips `1947-49` and `1971-74`, an arrow from parent bulge to child bulge. (Planted here; paid in the reversal.)
STORY wide: `whatif/Set` `park`, now crowded with teal toddlers and amber parents (the YOU parent with a teal kid).
BOARD interrupt: Music cuts; the navy board goes dark except the `KEEP THIS DATE` pin from s12 glowing on the grey bands; the key tick `30` flashes; chip `HANDOVER IN 0 YEARS`.

BOARD signature shot: Corner `whatif/YearStamp` `YEAR 30`; `whatif/Pyramid` at YEAR 30: amber bar at 30, teal echo bands at 0-12 below it, grey bands at 50-75 above. On m3 every grey band lifts off the top together (they step out; nobody dies) and a key icon drops from the grey into the amber bar; HUD `TOTAL ALIVE` 14.7 -> 13.0 BN.
BOARD: Same pyramid, nothing above the amber bar; Tag `OLDEST PERSON ALIVE: 30`.
STORY wide (callback to s35): `whatif/Set` `office` from s35, now with empty desks; the amber queue walks in and sits (YOU at the corner office); Tag `OPEN TODAY: EVERY SENIOR JOB`.

BOARD role panels: Four navy panels, each an amber 30-year-old `whatif/Person` with a hat: scrubcap `SURGEON · STILL IN TRAINING`, then wig `JUDGE 30`, cap `PILOT 30`, hardhat `POWER STATION 30` (no cockpit/OR/court sets).
STORY quiet: `whatif/Set` `kitchen`: the amber YOU adult holds an old recipe card in grey handwriting nobody can ask about; a teal kid at the table; an empty chair; Tag `GRANDPARENTS: 0`.
STAMP: `whatif/YearStamp` `YEAR 65` / `ONE MONDAY`; the rocking-chair tick on `whatif/Scrubber` lights.

STORY wide: `whatif/Set` `office` street side at 9:00: every door opens and amber elders (`whatif/Person` age elder, pose walk, holding a box) walk out at once; YOU among them; `explainer/Stat` `~6.3 BN RETIREES (EST.)`; HUD odds `1 IN 6,300,000,000`.
STORY: `whatif/Set` `office`: a single teal worker at a desk behind a tower of paperwork (stacked `rect`s).
BOARD: `whatif/IconRows`: `JAPAN TODAY 1 : 2`, then `YOUR WORLD 3 : 4` stacks beneath; source `Japan Statistics Bureau 2023`.
STORY button: `whatif/Set` `park`: a long queue of amber elders with a single flag icon at the far end; Tag `TEE TIMES: SOLD OUT`.
STORY dusk: `whatif/Set` `porch` at sunset: two amber elders in rocking-chair icons, one is YOU; corner `whatif/YearStamp` `YEAR 80` on r80b; HUD `YOUR AGE GROUP 3,800,000,000`.

STORY quiet: The 90-kid class grid from s26 returns as a framed photo on the porch wall; figures fade out of it to half (`whatif/Crowd` fadeOut 0 -> 0.5); `whatif/Pill` `~4× TODAY'S YEARLY DEATHS (EST.)`.
STORY quiet: The porch again: the YOU elder alone; the second rocking chair still rocking, empty.

BOARD signature shot: `whatif/Pyramid` YEAR 80: shrinking amber bar at 80, teal echo bands at 35-62, a softer second-echo band below; bands widen and blur (smoothed `bands` track); Tag `ECHO OF THE ECHO`.

BOARD (plant from s40 paid): Japan births line chart (`svg` path, 1945-2010): chip `1949 · 2.7 M`, chip `1973 · 2.1 M`, then a dotted bump outline `EXPECTED ~2000` with nothing under it; Tag `NEVER CAME`. Source `MHLW vital statistics`.
BOARD: `explainer/SpeedBars`: `YOUR BIRTHDAY 8,000,000,000` (off-frame) vs `ECHO'S BUSIEST DAY ~1,500,000 (EST.)` vs `TODAY ~360,000`; Tag `EACH WAVE: LOWER AND WIDER`.

BOARD: The chart outline morphs toward a pyramid; a thin cream outline of the 2024 pyramid from s10 overlays; inset: a 12-month calendar grid where each month lights with a family figure (`BIRTHDAYS IN YOUR FAMILY: 12 MONTHS`).

STAMP + BOARD: `whatif/YearStamp` `YEAR 100` / `THE CENTURY` (held 1.8 s), then the board: HUD switches to survivors mode; `explainer/Stat` `~40,000,000 AGED 100 (EST.)` with grey `TODAY ~0.72 M`; odds `1 IN 40,000,000`.
BOARD: A coin icon flips every 1.5 s above a row of 10 elder icons; half grey out each flip; `whatif/Pill` `105+: ~50% EACH YEAR` with source `Barbi et al., Science, 2018`.
BOARD: A red `ESTIMATE` stamp lands across the HUD; a dice icon tumbles in.

BOARD countdown: Corner `whatif/YearStamp` `YEAR 110`; HUD survivors `40,000` -> `20,000` (111) -> `10,000` (112) -> `5,000` (113) -> `~40` (120) on the VO beats while a `whatif/Crowd` elder grid halves each beat; odds line follows (`1 IN 40,000` ... `1 IN 40`).
BOARD: `whatif/Pill` `RECORD: 122 YEARS, 164 DAYS (1875-1997)` beside a generic cream elder silhouette (no likeness); a `122` marker drops onto the scrubber.
BOARD: The dice roll again; the scrubber dot creeps past the 122 marker; HUD `~7`.
STAMP: `whatif/YearStamp` `YEAR 125` / `ALIVE: 1`; HUD survivors `1`, odds `1 IN 1`.
STORY close: `whatif/Set` `kitchen`, morning: one amber elder at the table wearing the YOU ring with a small `?` (maybe it's you); `whatif/Cake` with one lit candle.

STORY wide (second-stage reveal): Pull out from the elder to reveal the whole table: teal, cream and new-colour `whatif/Person`s of every age (kid to adult), each with a small date tag (`MAR 3`, `JUL 19`, `FEB 29`, `NOV 1` ...).

STORY extreme close: Corner counter `BIRTHS THIS SECOND: 4` from s01 returns and flicks, through the kitchen window; then the single candle flame; the scrubber candle tick lights; HUD and scrubber fade out together.

STORY bookend + recap: `glitch` 0.2 s back to the s01 crib-field framing; the cribs dissolve into a horizontal recap icon timeline: bottle `DAY 1`, desk `YEAR 6`, key `YEAR 30`, rocking chair `YEAR 65`, candle `YEAR 125` (the same icons as the scrubber ticks).
BOARD: `whatif/Pyramid` 2024 real shape again; the gaps between bands glow; Tag `THE GAPS`.

STORY (three callbacks): `whatif/Set` `park` path, side-on: a toddler holding an adult's hand (callback 1:3x first steps), a teacher with a few kids (callback YEAR 6), an older figure handing a key to a younger one (callback YEAR 30); every figure a different shirt colour.
STORY: The same figures in one line, `point` poses; a glowing cream `circle` (the baton) travels along a path from elder to adult to teen to child; Tag `IT'S A RELAY`.
